description: One row per rendered frame: head pose, gaze ray, fixation state, and gaze-hit AOI. Mirrors gaze_*.csv from AttentionDataLogger.
note: pID / conditions / ts are auto-added by VERA — do NOT list them here.

columns.name: timestamp_utc_ms
columns.description: Unix epoch milliseconds (UTC). 13-digit value; use Float (double) or String — overflows a 32-bit Integer.

columns.name: frame
columns.description: Unity frame count at sample time.

columns.name: head_pos_x
columns.description: Head position X, world space, meters.

columns.name: head_pos_y
columns.description: Head position Y, world space, meters.

columns.name: head_pos_z
columns.description: Head position Z, world space, meters.

columns.name: head_rot_x
columns.description: Head rotation quaternion X, world space.

columns.name: head_rot_y
columns.description: Head rotation quaternion Y, world space.

columns.name: head_rot_z
columns.description: Head rotation quaternion Z, world space.

columns.name: head_rot_w
columns.description: Head rotation quaternion W, world space.

columns.name: gaze_origin_x
columns.description: Gaze ray origin X, world space.

columns.name: gaze_origin_y
columns.description: Gaze ray origin Y, world space.

columns.name: gaze_origin_z
columns.description: Gaze ray origin Z, world space.

columns.name: gaze_dir_x
columns.description: Gaze ray direction X, normalized, world space.

columns.name: gaze_dir_y
columns.description: Gaze ray direction Y, normalized, world space.

columns.name: gaze_dir_z
columns.description: Gaze ray direction Z, normalized, world space.

columns.name: gaze_source
columns.description: EyeTracking (Quest Pro) or HeadGaze (fallback).

columns.name: gaze_confidence
columns.description: Eye-tracker confidence; 1.0 for head gaze.

columns.name: angular_velocity_deg_s
columns.description: Gaze angular velocity (deg/s) used by the I-VT classifier.

columns.name: is_fixating
columns.description: Fixation state, 0/1 (Boolean encoded as int, matching our CSV).

columns.name: fixation_id
columns.description: Monotonically increasing fixation ID.

columns.name: hit_target
columns.description: AttentionTarget ID under the gaze ray; empty if none.

columns.name: hit_point_x
columns.description: Gaze-hit world point X; empty if no hit.

columns.name: hit_point_y
columns.description: Gaze-hit world point Y; empty if no hit.

columns.name: hit_point_z
columns.description: Gaze-hit world point Z; empty if no hit.

columns.name: hit_distance
columns.description: Distance from gaze origin to hit point; empty if no hit.
